title: Wind Shear Model
text: 计算风切变条件，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Units} 指定风切变单位 Metric；{Flight phase} 指定飞行阶段 Category C - Terminal Flight、{Wind speed at 20 ft altitude (kts)} 指定风速、{Wind direction at 20 ft altitude (degrees clockwise from north)} 指定风向，按实例取值。

params.name: Units
params.values: 风切变单位 Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Flight phase
params.values: 飞行阶段 Category C - Terminal Flight Phase (default) | Other

params.name: Wind direction at 20 ft altitude (degrees clockwise from north)
